title: Association between circulating microRNA-122, microRNA-126-3p and microRNA-146a and inflammatory markers
author: Hassan Mozaffari-Khosravi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bax5ifq6
materials: TNF alpha measurement by ELISA kit https://www.diaclone.com/documents/protocole/950.090_Human_TNFa_ELISA_kit_version_9.pdf
Incubation in thermocycler at 75 °C for 5 minute.
Incubation the mixture in thermocycler according to following temperature and duration and cycle:
After cDNA synthesis, add the following components:

steps.title: Prepare lysis reagent
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL RiboEx™ LS to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add blood sample
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL blood sample (if the original volume is 100 µL, adjust to 250 µL with PBS or RNase‑free water; minimum volume is 100 µL) and vortex vigorously.

steps.title: Incubate for leukocyte collapse
steps.instruction: Incubate 2 min at room temperature to allow leukocytes to collapse completely.

steps.title: Add chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL chloroform (or 0.1 mL 1‑bromo‑3‑chloropropane as an alternative), shake vigorously for 15 seconds, then let stand 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Collect the upper aqueous phase (~450 µL). Note: temperatures >8 °C may cause DNA to partition into the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Read initial absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of each well immediately after step 5.11 on a spectrophotometer using 450 nm as the primary wavelength and optionally 620 nm as the reference (acceptable range 610–650 nm).

steps.title: Add stop reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL H₂SO₄ stop reagent to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate after stop
steps.instruction: Incubate in the dark for 12–15 min at room temperature; protect from light by wrapping the plate in aluminium foil.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL ready‑to‑use TMB substrate solution to all wells.

steps.title: Wash plate (first)
steps.instruction: Perform the following wash three times: a) aspirate liquid from each well; b) dispense 0.3 mL 1× wash buffer into each well; c) aspirate the buffer; d) repeat steps b‑c two more times.

steps.title: Incubate after wash
steps.instruction: Cover with a plastic plate cover and incubate at 18–25 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin‑HRP
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Streptavidin‑HRP solution to all wells.

steps.title: Wash plate (second)
steps.instruction: Wash the plate with 1× wash buffer as described in step 9.

steps.title: Long incubation
steps.instruction: Cover with a plastic plate cover and incubate at 18–25 °C for 3 hours.

steps.title: Add anti‑TNFα antibody
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL diluted biotinylated anti‑TNFα to all wells.

steps.title: Add samples and standards
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of each sample, standard, control, and zero (standard diluent) in duplicate to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Prepare standard curve (first)
steps.instruction: Prepare the standard curve as required for the assay.

steps.title: Prepare standard curve (second)
steps.instruction: Prepare the standard curve (second mention).

steps.title: Add anti‑IL‑6 antibody
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL diluted biotinylated anti‑IL‑6 to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate anti‑IL‑6
steps.instruction: Cover with a plastic plate cover and incubate at 18–25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash plate (third)
steps.instruction: Wash the plate as in step 9.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin‑HRP (second)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Streptavidin‑HRP solution to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate second HRP
steps.instruction: Cover with a plastic plate cover and incubate at 18–25 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash plate (fourth)
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash procedure described in step 9.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate (second)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL ready‑to‑use TMB substrate solution to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate TMB (second)
steps.instruction: Incubate in the dark for 12–15 min at room temperature; protect from light with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Add final stop reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL H₂SO₄ stop reagent to all wells.

steps.title: Read final absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of each well immediately after step 4.11 using 450 nm as the primary wavelength and optionally 620 nm as the reference (acceptable range 610–650 nm).

steps.title: Prepare insulin standard curve
steps.instruction: Prepare the standard curve for the insulin ELISA kit.

steps.title: Add insulin samples and standards
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of each sample, standard, control, and zero (appropriate standard diluent) in duplicate to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Add insulin conjugate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of diluted conjugate Insulin‑R to all wells.

steps.title: Shake plate
steps.instruction: Shake the plate for 20–30 seconds at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate insulin detection
steps.instruction: Cover with a plastic plate cover and incubate at 18–25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash plate (insulin)
steps.instruction: Wash the plate three times: a) aspirate; b) add 0.35 mL 1× wash buffer; c) aspirate; d) repeat steps b‑c two more times.

steps.title: Add substrate (insulin)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL substrate solution to all wells.

steps.title: Incubate substrate (insulin)
steps.instruction: Incubate in the dark for 15 min at room temperature; protect from light with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Add stop reagent (insulin)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Stop Reagent to all wells and let the plate sit on the table without shaking for 15–20 seconds.

steps.title: Read insulin absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of each well immediately after step 6.9 using 450 nm as the primary wavelength and optionally 620 nm as the reference.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reaction mixture in a microcentrifuge tube to a total volume of 12 µL (components listed in the accompanying table).

steps.title: Place mixture on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice immediately and add the components as listed in the table.
